card.fires_on: Mostly the word "correct" (or its endings) meaning to fix a fault or defect, plus a few scattered spots such as the space before a percentage or date. The match is loose.

modes.label: Correct / fix
modes.description: The verb correct, or part of it, used for fixing a mistake or a defect.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space just before a percentage or date figure after a colon or the word from.

card.plain: It lights up on the word correct when it means to fix something, and in a few unrelated spots just before a number.
